lines.sub: Hi! This is Lira's Academy, lesson fifteen — “Plugins”.
lines.tts: Hi! This is Lira's Academy, lesson fifteen — Plugins.

lines.sub: Everyone needs something different: a gardener — weather and watering, a cook — menus, a traveller — exchange rates and a packing list.
lines.tts: Everyone needs something different: a gardener — weather and watering, a cook — menus, a traveller — exchange rates and a packing list.

lines.sub: Build everything in at once — and it's easy to get lost.
lines.tts: Build everything in at once — and it's easy to get lost.

lines.sub: That's why I have plugins — ready-made skills. You turn on only what you need.
lines.tts: That's why I have plugins — ready-made skills. You turn on only what you need.

lines.sub: Open the “Garden” plugin, enter your city and what grows there — and tap “Install”.
lines.tts: Open the Garden plugin, enter your city and what grows there — and tap Install.

lines.sub: Now just ask: “Will there be frost this week?” — I'll answer from your city's weather.
lines.tts: Now just ask: Will there be frost this week? — I'll answer from your city's weather.

lines.sub: Plugins can have scheduled jobs: every evening I'll check the forecast and warn you if there's frost at night.
lines.tts: Plugins can have scheduled jobs: every evening I'll check the forecast and warn you if there's frost at night.

lines.sub: Don't need it — “Remove”, in one tap. Nothing else in me changes.
lines.tts: Don't need it — Remove, in one tap. Nothing else in me changes.

lines.tts: In the studio — the Plugins section: what each one can do and what to say to it.
